[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Show the full parent task and its diff when capturing a sub-bullet[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]When a draft adds a sub-bullet under an existing task [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](`@route+block-id`, with or without `#section`, picker task refs, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and global `@@route+block-id` batches), the Bob Mac Capture preview[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shows the whole parent task as a card: the task line and every line[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]of its block, exactly as Bob will write them, with the new lines [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]marked as added. Bob computes the block and the diff. The app [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]decodes and renders it with the same diff card the Pomodoro blocks [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]use.[/#D7D7AF]
